assertions.name: C1_two_of_three_shapes_coincide
assertions.source: P1 CONFIRMED. 5_2 has 3 ideal tetrahedra and two of them carry the SAME shape: |z1 - z3| = 0.0 at 300-bit precision, while |z1 - z2| = 0.868837. So the shape multiset is (A, B, A), not three distinct values

assertions.name: C2_two_distinct_cubics_found_not_fitted
assertions.source: P2 CONFIRMED. Exhaustive search over monic integer cubics with |coef| <= 3 finds exactly one vanishing at each shape, and they differ: A = [(-1, 3, -2, 1)], B = [(-1, 1, -2, 1)]. Neither shape is a root of unity. The polynomials are FOUND by search and then verified symbolically below -- nothing is fitted

assertions.name: C3_same_field_disc_minus_23_signature_1_1
assertions.source: P3 CONFIRMED. disc(A) = -23 and disc(B) = -23, both -23, with signature (r1,r2) = (1, 1) and (1, 1). So the two cubics generate the SAME cubic field, of discriminant -23, by two different generators. The (1,1) signature independently reproduces what dt_d1b_trace_field_bar_grading_probe measured for 5_2 by exact Sturm counting -- a different computation reaching the same invariant

assertions.name: C4_bar_coordinates_exact_mod_cubic
assertions.source: The inverse and both bar coordinates verified as EXACT polynomial identities modulo each cubic, using Fraction remainder arithmetic in Q[z] rather than numerical comparison. A: z^-1 = z^2-2z+3, barEven = z^2-z+3, barOdd = -z^2+3z-3. B: z^-1 = (z-1)^2, barEven = z^2-z+1, barOdd = -z^2+3z-1. These are the statements the Lean file proves

assertions.name: C5_phi6_reappears_as_an_identity_only
assertions.source: The B-shape's bar-even coordinate is z^2 - z + 1 = Phi_6(z), the sixth cyclotomic polynomial whose VANISHING defines the 4_1 cusp shape. For 4_1 Phi_6 is zero; for 5_2's B-shape it is the bar-even coordinate. This is an IDENTITY, two lines from z^-1 = (z-1)^2 and proved as such in the Lean. Whether the reappearance means anything across the two knots is NOT claimed and NOT investigated -- reading significance into an algebraic coincidence is the failure mode this arc keeps hitting

assertions.name: C6_barEven_not_rational_the_4_1_story_does_not_transcribe
assertions.source: P4 CONFIRMED, and this is the substantive finding. Both cubics are monic with no integer root (rational roots: A [], B []), hence irreducible over Q, so each 5_2 shape has degree 3 and its barEven lies in the cubic field of discriminant -23. For 4_1, barEven(omega) = 1 is RATIONAL, which is exactly what lets the bar-even coordinate be the anchor-stable -Vol(4_1) part. So the 4_1 bar-parity story does NOT transcribe to 5_2 -- a NEGATIVE result

assertions.name: C7_two_equal_one_different_is_NOT_a_link
assertions.source: GUARD, not a result. The 5_2 shape multiset is (A,B,A) -- two equal, one different -- and the radical of eq (98) is (a,a,c) -- also two equal, one different. These must NOT be linked: the index sets are different (three tetrahedra versus three saddles sigma), no map between them is given anywhere in the corpus or the source, and the equal pair even sits at different positions ({1,3} against {1,2}). Matching shape is not matching structure. Recorded explicitly because this convergence is tempting enough to be mistaken for a finding

description: qou-rutm. The measurement side of QOU/QBeta/FiveTwoCuspShapeBarParity.lean, the 5_2 analogue of the corpus's CuspShapeBarParity (which does 4_1: both tetrahedra at omega with Phi_6(omega) = 0, barEven = 1, barOdd^2 = -3). Establishes: 5_2 has THREE ideal tetrahedra of which TWO SHARE A SHAPE (z1 = z3 != z2, exact at 300 bits); neither is a root of unity and both are CUBIC with DIFFERENT minimal polynomials, A (z1=z3) = z^3-2z^2+3z-1 and B (z2) = z^3-2z^2+z-1, found by exhaustive integer search; both have discriminant -23 and signature (1,1) so both generate the SAME cubic field by different generators, and that (1,1) independently reproduces the 5_2 signature measured by exact Sturm counting in dt_d1b_trace_field_bar_grading_probe. The bar coordinates are verified as EXACT identities modulo each cubic via Q[z] remainder arithmetic: A has z^-1 = z^2-2z+3, barEven = z^2-z+3, barOdd = -z^2+3z-3; B has z^-1 = (z-1)^2, barEven = z^2-z+1, barOdd = -z^2+3z-1. The B-shape's barEven IS Phi_6(z), the polynomial whose VANISHING defines the 4_1 cusp shape -- recorded as an IDENTITY, with no claim that the reappearance means anything. THE SUBSTANTIVE RESULT IS A NEGATIVE: both cubics are irreducible over Q, so neither 5_2 shape has rational barEven, whereas 4_1's barEven = 1 is rational and that is what makes it the anchor-stable -Vol(4_1) part. The 4_1 bar-parity story does NOT transcribe to 5_2. Also carries an explicit GUARD: the (A,B,A) shape pattern and eq (98)'s (a,a,c) radical are both two-equal-one-different and must NOT be linked -- different index sets, no map, different positions.
